tests.name: open_alerts
tests.cmd: open a0 CSV; a0 multi-word via FS_RAW; a1 ws-only

tests.name: words
tests.cmd: WORDSF level=error host=… → 3 tokens; CSV no-space → 1; ws → 0

tests.name: peel
tests.cmd: non-destructive level=error host=web-01 via keep copies

weaknesses.title: CUTF mutates source field to column text
weaknesses.detail: CUTF/COLUMNF replace the field with the peeled column (not non-destructive extract). Agents must copy to keep/level/host first. Silent data loss if keep omitted.
weaknesses.repro: CUTF a raw "," 1 → raw becomes web-01 only

weaknesses.title: Index var COL silently forces CUTF_I=0
weaknesses.detail: DEFAULT COL=2; CUTF x raw "," COL peels column 0 (a) with CUTF_I=0. Form-token collision with COLUMNF/COLF. Must use CIDX/COLI. Same class as SEP/FLOOR/CAP.
weaknesses.repro: DEFAULT COL=2; CUTF x raw "," COL → LAST a CUTF_I 0

weaknesses.title: Multi-word ARG2 needs quotes or CUBALC_FS_RAW
weaknesses.detail: CUBALC_ARG2=level=error host=web splits at shell; only first token reaches agent. Prefer CUBALC_FS_RAW for free-text alerts.

weaknesses.title: No single-object COPYF for keep backup
weaknesses.detail: COPYF is fleet class→field copy (COPYF Class src dst). Per-object backup needs GETF+SETF. Agents lack one-shot SNAPSHOTF on one object.
weaknesses.repro: COPYF a0 raw keep fails pattern; fleet only

weaknesses.title: WORDSF ignores commas (CSV is one token)
weaknesses.detail: error,web-01,timeout → ntok=1. Must CUTF for CSV; WORDSF only whitespace. Easy false friend when choosing tokenizer.

weaknesses.title: WRITE VAL omit trailing NL
weaknesses.detail: od -c META ends without \n after dump\na0.

weaknesses.title: REQUIRE=abc softens
weaknesses.detail: Non-numeric REQUIRE miss exit 0 on gate deny.

workarounds: Always keep field + GETF/SETF before destructive CUTF
Never name index COL — use CIDX (0-based) or COLI (1-based COLUMNF)
WORDSF for free text; CUTF for CSV — do not mix assumptions
Fixed a0/a1/a2; TRY* soft; numeric REQUIRE only
language_gaps: Non-destructive CUTF return-only (or CUTF INTO field)
Reserve COL/SEP/FLOOR/CAP in form numeric/sep arg slots
Native multi-word ARG shuttle without shell quotes
